text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon takes 1st, it's Hishi Amazon!
So strong, so powerful... She is unstoppable—!
(Waaaaaaahhh--!)

Like the wind, like a flash of light...
As Hishi Amazon tore past the finish line,
an explosive cheer enveloped her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! What was that?!
That was amazing, so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon... and Narita Brian too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was...
The one standing over there was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It was the "Amazon" Hishi Amazon, and the "Monster" Narita Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Did I... Did I actually do it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh...
...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Uoooooh!!
All right, let's goooo—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congra~~ts, Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, welcome back!
Narita Brian!!

Nakayama Racecourse was enveloped in thunderous applause.
Cries of "Do your best!" were no longer to be heard.

In a one-on-one duel that captivated everyone,
I remembered.
...that Narita Brian is a "monster."
On the way home that day—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...My thanks, Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this all of a sudden?
Is it about me lending you a handkerchief in the restroom?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, that's wrong. Are you an idiot?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Arima Kinen'.
You weren't half bad."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That was a great finish.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-What?!
Why are you acting so formal all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—So let's battle again.
Or in your words, a "one-on-one duel," is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You have a fire within you...
One that blazes hot and makes the heart race—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A scorching heat that makes one want to sink their teeth in.

As Narita Brian said that, her eyes shone brilliantly—
whether catching the sunset,
or reflecting Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...You really do have a beast inside you, don't you, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, nah, just talkin' to myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, "Narita Brian."
I won't pull any punches in our next one-on-one, either.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll win as many times as it takes!

And so, that fierce rematch—
the Arima Kinen—came to a close.
